content.value_statement: Proxmox teams need a clear view of node and workload health. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through monitoring, bottleneck analysis, and capacity planning.
actual_capabilities: Guides cluster health checks using available Proxmox resource metrics.
Reviews node CPU, memory, disk, and network utilization.
Analyzes VM and container performance for high resource usage.
Identifies likely bottlenecks across nodes, workloads, and storage.
Builds performance summaries for operations reviews and reports.
Supports capacity planning with utilization trends and growth projections.
limitations: Requires connected Proxmox monitoring tools and permission to read metrics.
Trend analysis depends on available historical performance data.
Does not configure alerts, dashboards, or automated remediation by itself.
The documented storage check references a tool not listed in available tools.

use_cases.title: Daily Cluster Health Review
use_cases.description: Check node and workload metrics before users report performance issues.

use_cases.title: Capacity Budget Planning
use_cases.description: Summarize utilization trends to justify hardware expansion or workload moves.

use_cases.title: Incident Performance Triage
use_cases.description: Find overloaded nodes, noisy VMs, and resource pressure during an incident.

prompt_templates.title: Check Cluster Health
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a quick health snapshot.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check current Proxmox cluster health. Summarize node status, workload pressure, and any urgent risks.

prompt_templates.title: Review Workload Performance
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for VM and container utilization.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze VM and container performance across the cluster. Highlight high CPU, memory, disk, and network usage.

prompt_templates.title: Find Performance Bottlenecks
prompt_templates.prompt: Identify likely Proxmox performance bottlenecks. Compare node, VM, container, storage, and network indicators before recommending actions.

prompt_templates.title: Create Capacity Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for planning future infrastructure needs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a capacity planning brief from current and historical Proxmox metrics. Include growth risks, upgrade priorities, and migration options.

output_examples.input: What is the current cluster health and performance?
output: Cluster health is stable, with one node near sustained memory pressure.
Two VMs show higher CPU usage than their baseline during business hours.
Recommended next step: rebalance workloads from the busiest node.

output_examples.input: Which nodes are running at high utilization?
output: Node pve-02 has the highest memory usage and limited available headroom.
Node pve-04 shows disk pressure that may affect backup windows.
The remaining nodes have enough spare CPU for normal workload bursts.

output_examples.input: Build a capacity planning summary for next quarter.
output: Current growth suggests memory will be the first limiting resource.
Storage usage needs review before adding large VM images.
Plan one memory upgrade and review VM placement before expanding compute.

best_practices: Review cluster, node, VM, and container metrics together before making changes.
Compare current utilization with baselines and known peak periods.
Document recommendations with metric evidence and expected operational impact.
anti_patterns: Do not assume one high metric proves the root cause.
Do not plan capacity from a single short observation window.
Do not move workloads without checking storage and network constraints.

faq.question: What Proxmox tasks does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports health checks, performance reviews, bottleneck analysis, reporting, and capacity planning.

faq.question: Does it change my Proxmox configuration?
faq.answer: No. The skill describes monitoring and analysis workflows, not configuration changes or remediation actions.

faq.question: Can it analyze both VMs and containers?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflow includes VM and container performance review.

faq.question: Can it forecast future resource needs?
faq.answer: It can support forecasts when current and historical utilization metrics are available.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What data access does it need?
faq.answer: It needs access to Proxmox monitoring tools that can read node, cluster, VM, and container metrics.
